questions.stem: What is the primary goal of achieving low coupling in a software system?

options.text: To make modules highly dependent on each other
To reduce the interdependence between modules
To ensure all modules have the same functionality
To maximize the number of modules in the system

questions.explanation: The correct answer is To reduce the interdependence between modules.
